item.title: Stop Making Claude Work Alone! 4 Ways to Bring Codex CLI and Gemini CLI Into the Mix
item.description: A hands-on tutorial for multi-AI collaboration in Claude Code. From MCP integration to the claude-octopus plugin, here are 4 methods to get Codex CLI and Gemini CLI working alongside Claude Code. Includes full configuration commands, Subagent templates, and an automated code review Hook script — all copy-paste ready.
